notes.title: New Release - LEGO® Star Wars™ III: The Clone Wars™
notes.notes:
LEGO® Star Wars™ III: The Clone Wars™ is now available in the Americas on Steam!

LEGO® Star Wars™ III: The Clone Wars™, the third in the beloved and critically acclaimed series, allows fans to explore endlessly and laugh their way through the Star Wars galaxy in the most humorous, accessible and action-packed LEGO game to date!
